sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 21 March 2026, pitch SYN-SYNCP000002-P1 was put before Maple Grove Regional Hospital 002 on behalf of Supplier.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 3 rebate of 4.5 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a DTaP preferred-position minimum of 80 per cent in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer signed off on the terms.
